text: Figure 1.2: Detailed L-SDU Router Structure The L-SDU Router module mainly consists of two parts: • The L-SDU Router routing paths : static routing paths describing the routing attributes for each L-SDU to be routed. The routing paths can be (if supported) updated post-build loadable in the programming state of the ECU or selected when initializing the L-SDU Router by post-build selectable (see section 10.1.1). • The L-SDU Router Engine: the actual code performing routing actions according to the L-SDU Router routing paths.
